task.name: stabilize_and_insert_block
task.description: Use the left arm to contact and stabilize the green block, then use the right arm to assemble the small block into its rightmost slot.\nSuccess condition: All actions completed in order, the small block is inserted into the rightmost slot.

substages.substage: 1. move left arm to green block
2. contact green block with left arm
3. stabilize green block with left arm
4. move right arm to small block
6. move and align small block to rightmost slot
7. insert small block into rightmost slot
